title: I Don't Have Wings
description: Inspired by the yet-to-be-published book of the same name, this mod adds a new dimension with ultra-powerful mobs known as Angels, but also lots of loot for those who evade them.
body:
Inspired by the yet-to-be-published book of the same name, this mod adds a new dimension with ultra-powerful mobs known as Angels, but also lots of loot for those who evade them.

New content:
- 1 new dimension
  - 2 exclusive biomes
  - 3 unimpressive blocks
  - 3 new mobs (the Angels)
    - Similar to the Warden, these are meant to be avoided, not killed
    - A gamerule exists to toggle their spawning
    - There's also an enchantment that makes weapons deal significantly more damage to them, if you're crazy enough to fight them
- 1 new music disc (currently Creative-only)
- 1 experimental liquid that pulls instead of pushes (also Creative-only)
- 1 mysterious voice in your head guiding you along
